verdict.rationale: The evidence supports local and dev instances. Grafana is an open-source project on GitHub with OSS docs. Loki is documented to "try it locally" in single-binary mode with a filesystem backend and Grafana Alloy. The as-code CLI is described as suitable for local development, and file-based provisioning of data sources and dashboards lets a dev instance be reproduced from version control. A free tier covers personal and experimental projects, and community users describe running Grafana internally. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party quick-start for running Grafana itself locally (e.g. Docker or binary install), and no hands-on report of using a local instance to test instrumentation end to end.
